sourceFreeze: Final frontend changes including editable Markdown fallback; parent build:pages passed after freeze. Shared dist read only for final measurement.
runtime: Actual local web application, fresh-local setup and demo-local seeded records, real portable authorized mutations and persisted local data. No mocked calendar queries. Rich-editor failure cases deliberately abort only the rich-editor module request.
changes: Reusable controlled month/week/list calendar, accessible internal month scrolling and stacked phone week layout, real source event selection.

Saved-view calendar mode hydration/save/save-as/discard and captured persisted snapshots; stable store handle prevents ordinary query refresh from falsely invalidating a legitimate save while original scope/creator/role checks remain.
Tasks phone list honors calendar/kanban choices; existing saved Task view opens actual edit drawer.
Deadline calendar/table event handoff to permissioned detail/edit drawer; immediate rich text save reads authoritative editor handle.
Rich Milkdown/Crepe editor lazy split preserves public types, ref, draft, readOnly and queued focus/set text; failed chunk import offers editable Markdown textarea or read-only text.
Existing web vector PDF renderer and pdf-lib deferred until export; native print bridge and existing fallback retained.

changedSourceEslint.note: Existing size/complexity warnings and Deadlines allRecords memo-dependency warning; editor wrapper/calendar component lint clean.

checks.calendarDateChecks: passed: strict date-only parsing, invalid dates, offset timestamps, Monday week boundaries through DST in Vancouver, Toronto and UTC

actualPdfAssertions: Renderer module absent before export and loaded on demand
Browser download starts with %PDF- and parses into at least one page
pdftotext contains the existing AGM title and persisted Adopted the agenda decision
initialHarnessCorrections: Three original Firefox calendar lifecycle cases completed functionality but reported cancelled Layout dynamic import during test navigation before setup shell settled; awaiting initialized shell before full navigation produced 3/3 clean reruns with no page errors.

One strengthened Task check assumed a preview Open button; recorded saved Task view actually opens Edit task directly. Interrupted that suite, asserted the configured enabled drawer, then reran all 8 projects successfully.

bundle.measurement: Vite manifest static import closure, JavaScript only; gzip estimated per chunk using Python gzip; excludes dynamic imports, CSS and local backend initialization
remaining: Deferred rich editor still weighs about 1.375MB raw when used.
LocalDataClient portable backend chunk remains about 1.2MB raw and is required for offline data.
DOCX preview and other large feature modules remain; no blanket bundle-budget/CoreWebVitals qualification.
Missing uncached rich editor chunks now fall back to editable Markdown text; other uncached web/PWA routes/features still have cache boundaries. Packaged Electron has all build chunks on disk.
bundle.baselineDescription: Working tree based on 66b8dcd; before/after snapshots captured around bounded editor/vector-PDF lazy-loading changes while other agents worked on unrelated gaps.
bundle.finalBuild: Root build:pages shared dist, read-only measurement 2026-10-05 after final frontend freeze

limitations: Linux desktop engines with viewport/touch emulation; no physical mobile hardware qualification.
Downloaded WebKit cannot launch because this runtime lacks its native libraries; Safari/iOS and WebKit remain unqualified.
Selected calendar/editor/PDF surfaces only; this does not qualify every module in Firefox.
Fallback test intercepts one unavailable module asset, not whole-site network-offline execution; writes and reload persistence use actual local data.

Uncached web/PWA routes and other deferred feature assets can still require prior online loading. Rich editor import failure now remains usable as plain Markdown. Electron packaged assets remain on disk.
No live hosted provider, Convex or PowerSync replication assertion in this local browser suite; parent live/auth/role suites supply separate coverage.
Bundle numbers estimate JavaScript static import closures, exclude dynamic imports/CSS/portable backend initialization and do not prove network timing or CoreWebVitals.
